replay.note: the advocates' outputs were replayed from an earlier run and not regenerated by this one: only the judge was called, so the figures here measure the judge's behaviour on fixed inputs and not the whole pipeline

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this was a RYDE_POOL (pooled) booking, and the fare is tested against the pooled itinerary the platform matched and the app told the rider about, not the rider's solo route.

To the rider: the 15.8 km in your claim is trip_record.solo_optimal_distance_km, which the record carries for reference only. Under POL-RD-12 the baseline for a pooled trip is the matched-itinerary optimal, trip_record.optimal_distance_km of 19.40 km — the Punggol to Hougang co-rider pickup to Raffles Place route the app quoted in MSG-00113-001 at 18:42:04, which the chat log shows you read at 18:42:31, before the trip started at 18:47:10. Measured against that baseline, the governing GPS figure of 20.18 km on EV-GPS-00113 gives an excess of 0.78 km, or 4.02%. POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is greater than both 0.8 km and 20% of optimal; 0.78 km falls 20 metres short of the absolute limb and 4.02% is far below the percentage limb, so no deviation is established and no fare recomputation under POL-RD-02 arises. The '28% longer' you calculated compares the pooled route with your solo route; the co-rider match is what lengthened the itinerary, and POL-RD-12 excludes distance attributable to a platform-matched co-rider collection by name. The Hougang stop you queried was that pickup, shown on the trace as the boarding pause and explained contemporaneously in MSG-00113-003.

To the driver: nothing turns on you beyond that arithmetic. The trace is unimpaired (217 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps), so no POL-RD-07 question arises and no independent corroboration is needed. No POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04 or POL-RD-05 exoneration was required or relied on; the absent traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00113-01 (status MISSING, weight 0.0) is irrelevant because no closure is asserted. The POL-RD-06 profile check is not engaged — the excess is far below the 8.0 km / 50% material gate — and in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 471 completed trips, so no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral arise.

On the fare: EV-FARE-00113 is METERED on rate card RC-SG-2026Q3-RYDEPOOL and its lines reconcile to the $26.83 charged (base 3.80 + distance 15.15 + time 10.08 + platform fee 0.80 − pool discount 3.00). There are no ERP gantries and no airport surcharge, so no billing-integrity correction under POL-RD-09(4) is available. The claim is not supported, the present state stands, and the $6.00 contested remains as charged. No clause produces a referral, and the evidence is complete, consistent and carried at full weight, so confidence is 0.95 — above the 0.70 floor — and the case is not escalated.
